lsb_checksum.note: Presented as a cheaper bit test in addChecksum (testing bit i instead of 7-i); the checksum bits are appended in reverse order, so the last word of every phrase is wrong for most entropies.

skip_revalidate.note: Presented as dropping a redundant IsMnemonicValid pass because the reverse-map loop rejects unknown words anyway; word-count errors now come from the size check with a different message, and phrases with doubled or leading spaces fail on an empty word instead of 'Invalid mnemonic'. Upstream tests only check that an error is returned.

fieldsfunc.note: Presented as making word splitting Unicode-consistent with strings.FieldsFunc(unicode.IsSpace); strings.Fields already splits on exactly those runes and has an ASCII fast path, so this only adds a function call per rune.
